body:
Events feed fixed -- both the data AND the root cause.

ROOT CAUSE FOUND: update-tungsten-events.ps1 hardcoded pwsh.exe at "C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe" -- wrong on this machine (PS7 is installed via the Windows Store app package, actual path under C:\Program Files\WindowsApps\...). Confirmed via .tungsten-events-refresh-error.log: EVERY refresh attempt since at least 2026-07-10 (07-10, 07-27, 08-03) hit this exact check and silently gave up before ever launching Claude -- even though the scheduled task itself reported success every week, because it only launched the wrapper script, which then failed past the log file where Task Scheduler couldn't see it. Fixed by resolving pwsh.exe dynamically via Get-Command instead of a second hardcoded guess.

IMMEDIATE FIX: refreshed TUNGSTEN_events.csv myself rather than waiting for next Monday's tick -- 7 events, USD + AUD, Aug 6-14 (NFP Aug 7 verified via BLS-sourced search, RBA decision Aug 11 verified with AEST->UTC conversion, weekly jobless claims + CPI/PPI/retail sales on the standard BLS cadence). Could not confirm in-window ECB/BoJ/BoE/BoC dates (their next meetings appear to fall outside Aug 5-19) -- left them out rather than guess, per the skill's own 'sparse but honest' guidance. Written atomically (tmp + rename).
